value.finding: Hokuriku Electric final report (METI new-energy WG, 25 Jun 2014): fire at unit 2 caused by lightning — the hydraulic cylinder (head–rod gap) became part of the lightning current path because a down conductor had been routed along the cylinder in 2004 without the turbine maker's approval; the arc damaged the seal, hydraulic oil sprayed out and ignited. No casualties stated. Both 900 kW units of Kunimidake were decommissioned (廃止) because of ageing and winter-lightning trouble.

note_zh: 風場層沒有 2002 年的國見岳風力發電所（900 kW×2，2010 年起北陸電力）；只有 2027 年的新計畫「Fukui Kunimidake wind farm」（37.8 MW，東北電力，宣布階段），不是同一座，維持不對應。北陸電力 2014-06-25 最終報告（經產省新能源發電設備事故對應 WG 第 4 回資料）：起火原因是落雷時雷電流經油壓缸（2004 年譲受前未經風機廠確認把導雷線沿油壓缸布設），電弧損傷密封、操作油噴出著火；1、2 號機因老化與冬季雷故障增加已廢止。
note_en: The layer has no record of the 2002 Kunimidake plant (2 x 900 kW, Hokuriku Electric from 2010); 'Fukui Kunimidake wind farm' (37.8 MW, Tohoku Electric, 2027, announced) is a different later project, so the event stays unlinked. Hokuriku Electric's final report of 25 Jun 2014 (METI WG, 4th meeting): lightning current ran through the hydraulic cylinder (a down conductor had been routed along it in 2004 without the maker's approval), the arc damaged the seal and the sprayed hydraulic oil ignited; both units were later decommissioned because of ageing and winter-lightning trouble.

value.finding: Operator AOW's cause statement of 28 Sep 2023: both leaks were on the same turbine. 11 Sep: a Vestas Japan maintenance worker damaged the gearbox oil-sensor connection by a wrong operation during an oil-sensor inspection (lubricating oil, up to about 3 L estimated). 23 Sep: before the damaged part was repaired, Vestas Japan mis-operated its remote system and restarted the oil pump, sending oil into the gearbox and out through the same damaged point (up to about 280 L outside the nacelle; the oil on the sea was recovered with absorbent mats under Akita Coast Guard guidance). AOW ordered Vestas Japan to tighten staff training and site/turbine monitoring. No casualties are mentioned; no regulator (METI/NITE) finding was found.

note_zh: AOW 2023-09-28「漏油發生の原因について」：9/11 是 Vestas Japan 作業員檢查增速機油感測器時誤操作、弄壞感測器接頭（潤滑油，最多約 3 L）；9/23 是接頭修復前 Vestas Japan 遠端系統誤操作重啟油泵，從同一處再漏（機艙外最多約 280 L，海面以吸附墊回收，秋田海上保安部指導）。業主要求 Vestas Japan 加強教育與監視。未見主管機關的調查結論。對應風場層「Noshiro Port」。
note_en: AOW's 28 Sep 2023 cause notice: on 11 Sep a Vestas Japan worker damaged the gearbox oil-sensor connection by a wrong operation (lubricating oil, up to about 3 L); on 23 Sep, before repair, Vestas Japan mis-operated its remote system, restarting the oil pump so oil leaked again from the same point (up to about 280 L outside the nacelle, recovered with absorbent mats under Coast Guard guidance). No regulator finding found. Maps to the layer record 'Noshiro Port'.

value.finding: No official final cause published as of 11 Oct 2026. Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment press release (5 Feb 2026): investigation under way, special safety inspection (5–27 Feb) of 80 turbines over 20 years old or of the same maker/capacity. Interim (operator Yeongdeok Wind Power and Korea Electrical Safety Corp., reported 25 Mar 2026): a fault in the alarm sensor controlling blade speed; blades over-sped and tore, then struck the tower; no tower-fatigue problem; investigation stalled over the manufacturer's cooperation. No casualties on 2 Feb (unit 21). The separate 23 Mar 2026 fire at unit 19 killed three workers.

note_zh: 對應風場層「Yeongdeok」（39.6 MW，Vestas V80 1.65 MW×24，2005）。2/2 塔架折彎（21 號機）未見官方最終原因：氣候能源環境部 2026-02-05 說原因調查中、對 80 部老舊或同型機特別安全檢查（2/5–2/27）；3/25 報導營運公司與電氣安全公社暫定結論是控制葉片轉速的警報感測器異常、葉片超速撕裂後擊中塔架，塔架無疲勞問題，因製造商配合問題調查停滯。2/2 無人傷亡；3/23 的 19 號機火災 3 名工人死亡是另一事件。
note_en: Maps to the layer record 'Yeongdeok' (39.6 MW, 24 x Vestas V80 1.65 MW, 2005). No official final cause for the 2 Feb tower collapse (unit 21): the ministry (5 Feb 2026) said the investigation was under way and ordered a special inspection of 80 old/same-type turbines; an interim finding reported on 25 Mar 2026 (operator and Korea Electrical Safety Corp.) blames a blade-speed alarm sensor fault (over-speed, blade tore and struck the tower; no tower fatigue), with the probe stalled over manufacturer cooperation. No casualties on 2 Feb; the 23 Mar fire at unit 19 (three workers killed) is a separate event.

sources.quote: 기후에너지환경부(장관 김성환, 이하 ‘기후부’)는 최근 발생한 영덕 풍력발전기 타워꺽임 사고(2.2일, 오후 4시 40분)와 관련하여, 국민불안을 해소하고 추가 사고를 예방하기 위해 노후 풍력발전기에 대한 특별안전점검(’26.2.5.~2.27.)을 실시한다고 밝혔다.
사고원인에 대한 조사가 진행 중인 가운데 유사사고 발생 가능성이 있는 노후 발전기(20년 이상 가동) 또는 동일 제조사·동일 용량 발전기 80기가 대상이다.
영덕풍력발전과 전기안전공사 등은 사고 이후 조사를 통해 블레이드(날개) 속도를 제어하는 알람센서에 이상이 있었다고 잠정 결론을 내렸다.
사고 이후 점검을 통해 센서 이상을 파악했지만 제조사 협조 문제로 현재 조사가 지지부진한 상태다.
지난 23일 오후 1시 11분쯤 영덕읍 창포리 풍력발전단지 내 풍력발전기 19호기에서 불이 나 발전기에 올라가서 수리하던 작업자 3명이 지상 출입구와 추락한 블레이드(날개)에서 숨진 채 발견됐다. 지난달 2일에는 가동 중이던 풍력발전기 21호기의 블레이드(날개) 파손에 따른 타워구조물(기둥) 꺾임 사고가 났다.
다행히 인명 피해는 발생하지 않았지만 추가 사고 발생 우려로 발전단지 내 발전기 전체를 전력차단하고 가동중지했다. 해당 단지에 설치된 발전기는 총 24(사유지 10기·군유지 14시)기로 2004~2005년 조성됐다.

value.finding: Control Yuan investigation report (23 Jul 2026, member 葉宜津) quoting the Ministry of Economic Affairs: unit 17 was running normally with no alarm, no maintenance scheduled, no lightning and no temperature alarm, so the cause was judged to be a short-circuit fault of electrical equipment inside the nacelle that spread to the whole nacelle. The Control Yuan found Taipower at fault for not noticing that unit 17 had the most faults of the 23 turbines (over twice the average) in Jan 2024–Apr 2026. Unit 17 belongs to phase 2 (8 units, commercial May 2010; phase 1 15 units, Jan 2009). No casualties are mentioned in the official statements.

note_zh: 對應風場層「Yunmai (Mailiao)」（台電雲麥，23×Vestas V80 2 MW）。監察院 2026-07-23 調查報告引經濟部回覆：事故前正常運轉、無警報、未排維修、無雷擊、無溫度警報，研判是「機艙內電氣設備短路故障造成起火」延燒整座機艙；監察院認為 17 號機 113/1–115/4 故障次數為 23 支中最高、逾平均 2 倍，台電未察有疏失。第 1 期 15 支 98 年 1 月商轉、第 2 期 8 支 99 年 5 月商轉（17 號屬第 2 期）——與風場層「16 in 2008, 7 in 2011」不符，建議核對。官方文件未提傷亡。
note_en: Maps to the layer record 'Yunmai (Mailiao)' (Taipower, 23 x Vestas V80 2 MW). The Control Yuan report of 23 Jul 2026 quotes the MOEA: normal operation, no alarms, no maintenance, no lightning, no temperature alarm, so the cause was judged a short circuit of electrical equipment in the nacelle that spread through it; the Control Yuan faulted Taipower for ignoring unit 17's fault record (highest of 23, over twice the average). Phase 1: 15 units, Jan 2009; phase 2: 8 units, May 2010 (unit 17) — this differs from the layer's '16 in 2008, 7 in 2011', worth checking. No casualties mentioned.

value.finding: No official cause published as of 11 Oct 2026. Energy Administration (21 Aug 2026): the turbine faulted at 03:29 on 8 Aug, tripped automatically, parts caught fire about 05:00 and the fire stopped at 06:30; no staff on site, partial damage to the turbine only, no casualties; the operator was ordered to clarify the cause. MOEA (27 Aug 2026): affected capacity about 14 MW, below the lowest reportable grade. Ørsted (1 Sep 2026): a possible overheating area identified in a preliminary way; the cause is still being investigated with Siemens Gamesa. A separate blade failure on another turbine of the same farm on 2 Oct 2026 (no casualties; Siemens Gamesa leading the investigation).

note_zh: 對應風場層「Greater Changhua 2b & 4」（大彰化西北 G05 屬此筆）。截至 2026-10-11 無官方起火原因：能源署 8/21 說 8/8 03:29 故障跳脫、約 05:00 起火、06:30 熄滅，現場無人、僅風機部分受損、無人傷亡，已要求業者釐清原因；經濟部 8/27 說影響容量約 14 MW；沃旭 9/1 說初步釐清可能過熱區域、仍與西門子歌美颯調查；10/2 同場另一風機葉片損毀（無人傷亡）是另一事件。
note_en: Maps to 'Greater Changhua 2b & 4' (G05 is the Changhua 4 / north-west site). No official cause as of 11 Oct 2026: the Energy Administration (21 Aug) gave the timeline (fault 03:29, fire about 05:00, out 06:30), no staff on site, partial damage, no casualties, operator ordered to clarify the cause; MOEA (27 Aug) put the affected capacity at about 14 MW; Ørsted (1 Sep) said a possible overheating area was identified preliminarily and the investigation with Siemens Gamesa continues; a blade failure on another turbine on 2 Oct 2026 is a separate event.

根據業者說明，該風機於凌晨3時29分發生故障，系統隨即啟動保護機制並自動跳脫停機；約上午5時，部分設備出現著火情形，至6時30分火勢停止。
本次事故影響裝置容量約14MW未達丙級規模，業者已於火災緊急處置後向能源署通報，符合通報規定
本次事故能源署已發函要求業者提供火災事故調查及風機修復計畫，後續將檢視事故原因，提出改善意見
沃旭能源今天表示，已初步釐清可能的過熱區域，目前還在與風機系統供應商西門子歌美颯調查事故原因，尚待最終調查結果。
大彰化西北離岸風場一座風機2日中午發生葉片損毀。沃旭能源今天說明，確認無人傷亡，附近海域亦已採取安全管制，後續風機系統原廠西門子歌美颯將主導並負責事件調查。
